pull-request-header: :robot: Release PR. Merging it pushes the version tag, which publishes the ghcr.io Docker image and the MCP registry entry.
pull-request-footer: Squash-merge with the title above unchanged: the title becomes the release commit. To ship a different version, do not edit this PR; set `release-as` on the package in release-please-config.json (see docs/releasing.md), and this PR will retarget.
